unit: P4: MYNN surface layer + GSL orographic drag whole launches (hrrrv5, MPAS physics route)
route: generated (type substitution of the captured forward source) + hand (driver conversions)

build.compiler: NVRTC 13.2 (the forward's compiler family), options = forward strict options + -arch + -DP4_MODE_TL|-DP4_MODE_REV

mynnsfc.upstream: RRFS MYNN-SFC @1d6e370e (NOAA GSL, US government code)

ugwp.upstream: MPAS physics_noaa/UGWP/bl_ugwp.F (NOAA GSL, US government code); libm words MIT (Arm optimized-routines, notice travels in the verbatim source)

build.generator: tree/ad/phys/p4/gen (Rust): verbatim forward source + p4_ad.cuh + physics part with float -> ADF, functions renamed adx_*; every textual pattern must match its expected count or generation stops

types.TL: ADF = {float v; double t}; v from the forward's own float operation on the forward's float operands (bitwise primal), t from double partials
types.REV: ADF = {float v; int node}; per-thread Wengert tape of (parents, double partials) in a per-call workspace; the reverse sweep is the exact transpose of the TL partials
types.precision: tangents and adjoints are double inside every entry; the plain entries read/write float32 buffers (one rounding), the *64 entries double buffers

branch_policy.what: every float comparison, while-loop test, if
branch_policy.policy: executed-arm (taken on v exactly as the forward)
min-max: derivative of the returned operand; tie -> left operand; NaN -> the non-NaN operand (fmaxf semantics)

branch_policy.what: (int) of a float (psi table cell nzol, GSL wind direction idir)
branch_policy.policy: lookup: index fixed, interpolation weights active, table entries constant

branch_policy.what: iterations (zolri/zolri2 secant and fixed-point loops, n<20, tol 0.01)
branch_policy.policy: iteration: derivative through the executed iterations, count as recorded
value from the forward's own routine; partial of the true function at the float operand (double)

branch_policy.what: sqrt or log at exactly 0, pow(0, y<1), pow(x<=0, active y)
branch_policy.policy: declared singular partial := 0, counted (singular_partials in the receipt)

tables.name: psim_stab, psim_unstab, psih_stab, psih_unstab (1001 each)
tables.built_by: mynnsfc_tables (verbatim float builder, run once per derivative module)

mynnsfc_tables.reason: builds constant psi tables; no derivative; the derivative modules run it once at load

mynnsfc_from_mpas.rules: d f.dx = 0 (dx from meshDensity); d sea = d f; sea.qsfc/xland/mavail/znt constants -> 0; f.xland -> 0; sea.tsk = fmaxf(sst,271.4): executed arm, tie -> sst

entries.tl: mynnsfc_from_mpas__tl(f, sea, density, sst, ice, len_disp, threshold, fraction, n, d_f, d_sea, d_sst)
entries.ad: mynnsfc_from_mpas__ad(f, sea, density, sst, ice, len_disp, threshold, fraction, n, b_f, b_sea, b_sst)

args.f: inout [68,n], all 68 rows active (xland, lakemask, dx are never perturbed by the proofs: categorical / geometry)

mynnsfc_columns.note: first on the packed (land/ice) array, second on the open-water sea array

entries.tl: mynnsfc_columns__tl(f, options, vegtype, xice_threshold, present, n, step_override, init_override, d_f, singular) grid (n+127)/128 x 128; d_f holds the pre tangent and receives the post tangent
entries.aug: mynnsfc_columns__aug(f, f_out, errors, options, vegtype, xice_threshold, present, n, step_override, init_override, br, br_words, br_count)
entries.ad: mynnsfc_columns__ad(f, options, vegtype, xice_threshold, present, n, step_override, init_override, b_f, ab, w, adj, cap, stride, col0, ncols, counts, overflow, singular); call once with ab = 0 (count pass, counts[c] = tape nodes), then per column chunk with workspace ab int2[cap*stride], w double2[cap*stride], adj double[cap*stride]; f must hold the PRE state; b_f holds the post cotangent and receives the pre cotangent

args.f: inout [68,n] (BLEND rows blended where threshold <= ice < 1)

entries.tl: mynnsfc_to_mpas__tl(f, sea, ice, threshold, n, d_f, d_sea, d_ice)
entries.ad: mynnsfc_to_mpas__ad(f, sea, ice, threshold, n, b_f, b_sea, b_ice); f = pre state

entries.tl: ugwp_oro_dx__tl(density, dx, length, n, d_dx): d_dx = 0
entries.ad: ugwp_oro_dx__ad(density, dx, length, n, b_dx): b_dx = 0

entries.tl: ugwp_oro_diff__tl(before, after, diff, n, d_before, d_after, d_diff)
entries.ad: ugwp_oro_diff__ad(before, after, diff, n, b_before, b_after, b_diff): b_after += b_diff, b_before -= b_diff, b_diff = 0

args.layers: in [10,59,nc] uproj vproj t1 q1 prsl prslk zl dz rublten rvblten
args.status: out int (entries write a scratch status)

entries.tl: ugwp_oro_run__tl(layers, prsi0, surface, kpbl0, out, sout, status, g, cp, rd, rv, fv, pi_c, dt, nz, nc, diags, d_layers, d_prsi0, d_surface, d_out, d_sout, scratch_status, singular, rbw) grid (nc+63)/64 x 64; writes d_out/d_sout of written slots only
entries.aug: ugwp_oro_run__aug(<forward args>, br, br_words, br_count, rbw)
entries.ad: ugwp_oro_run__ad(<forward args>, b_layers, b_prsi0, b_surface, b_out, b_sout, ab, w, adj, cap, stride, col0, ncols, counts, overflow, singular, scratch_status); count pass with ab = 0, then column chunks; b_layers/b_prsi0/b_surface accumulate; b_out/b_sout of written slots are consumed and zeroed

saved: none persistent: the adjoint recomputes the column from the pre state into its workspace (no aug tape between calls)
workspace: 32 bytes per tape node per column in a chunk; measured max nodes per column in the receipt
